Priya (CSM): Heads-up: Cobalt Systems renewal flagged. Daily tokens down ~60% after our champion left; new Eng Manager Alyssa is running a NovaAI eval. :eyes:
Tomas (AM): Oof. Which APIs dropped most? embeddings or rerank?
Priya (CSM): Batch embeddings and reranking. Volume ~120k -> 48k/day. They've paused Dedicated trial.
Alex (Solutions Eng): I can run a perf/cost delta for their avg seq lengths. Priya, can you share a couple anonymized prompt samples + seq distribution?
Priya (CSM): DMing samples now. Also attaching two failed examples they flagged.
Jordan (Sales): Renewal in 6w. Propose a short commercial: 2-week dedicated bench + credit vs a quick 3mo discount. Frame as "performance validation" to calm procurement.
Tomas (AM): Action: assemble a 1-pager for Monday call: usage trend, p50/p95/p99 by seq len, cost delta vs NovaAI, onboarding checklist. Owners?
Priya (CSM): I'll own the call & checklist. Alex owns perf slides. Jordan owns the commercial options.
eng-bot: deploy 1755558000 cobalt-dedicated-bench started; ETA 2h
Priya (CSM): Goal: 1-pager by EOD Sunday, call Monday 10am PT. Any blockers?
Alex (Solutions Eng): None. Will deliver perf charts by Sunday afternoon.
Jordan (Sales): I'll prep draft offer language and a fast-path SOW if procurement asks.
Priya (CSM): Thanks — will update once call scheduled.
